review_evidence: README identifies Leaff as an alpha diff tool for comparing Lean environments/olean files and reporting declaration changes between library revisions.

The implementation modules define environment hashing/diff data structures and CLI behavior. The only theorem declarations found by complete source scan are tiny test fixtures such as 1 = 1, 1 + 1 = 2, and 3 ≠ 9 used to exercise diff detection.
Inspection of Leaff/Diff.lean and test/diffin.lean confirms that the proposition-bearing snippets are deliberately change-detection fixtures rather than an independent mathematical development.

source_action.content_invariant: All 19 primary Lean files were classified as environment-diff implementation, CLI/build support, or diff-test fixtures. The handful of proposition declarations are trivial fixtures whose role is to test declaration-change reporting; no independent mathematical formalization is lost by retirement.
